questions.question: According to Census of India 2011, which group of union territories recorded less than 10% decadal population growth rate?
options: Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Chandigarh
Lakshadweep and Andaman and Nicobar Islands
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Lakshadweep and Andaman and Nicobar Islands) है।

questions.question: Which of the following was the objective of the slogan ‘Go back to the Vedas’?
options: To propagate the true knowledge of the Vedas
To popularise the Vedas to preserve Indian culture
To understand the medication through the Vedas
To learn Sanskrit to understand the Vedas
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (To propagate the true knowledge of the Vedas) है।

options: It is an apex body to facilitate money supply.

questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (It is an apex body to facilitate rural financing.) है।
